rapport_notes: Thorough and patient itemizing a complex garage/patio inventory, and clear when answering the travel-fee question.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "do you have any concern about the moving process?" - asked only right before pricing, after nearly all discovery (garage, patio, boxes, appliances) had already happened
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A - customer said 'No' when finally asked, so no concern was surfaced

top_strength: Thoroughly itemized a complex two-story-to-two-story move including garage and patio contents, and made a genuine ask ('would you like me to secure your truck for you?') at the end.
coaching_note: The agenda question came after nearly the entire discovery process instead of before it — asking it first would let any concerns shape the rest of the call instead of being an afterthought.
